magnitude.boundary: Reported cholera and acute watery diarrhoea in WHO multi-country emergency updates; not modeled total cholera burden, all waterborne pathogens, laboratory-confirmed cases only or a population incidence rate.

transformations.formula: Divide latest reported cholera/AWD cases by the prior near-complete annual reporting period and cap at one.
Calculate deaths divided by cases and normalize against the WHO under-one-percent benchmark, retaining five percent as the source-described vulnerable-setting extreme.
Calculate year-over-year reported death growth over compatible near-complete periods; improvements floor at zero rather than becoming negative urgency.
Divide regions reporting cases by all six WHO regions; countries remain a contextual count.

receipts.uncertainty: Reports combine cholera and acute watery diarrhoea under country-specific case definitions and surveillance systems. Underreporting, verification, reporting delays, laboratory confirmation, community deaths and differing observation cutoffs affect comparison.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: WHO supplies compatible near-complete 2024 and 2025 global emergency-reporting periods, reported cases and deaths, a recognized under-1% case-fatality benchmark, and quantified country and regional extent.
